department: School of Engineering and Applied Science: Computer Science PhD

deadline.value: Priority deadline for Fall 2027 entry is December 1, 2026; the final deadline is January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: To apply for Fall semester entry, the priority deadline is December 1. The final deadline is January 15.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for doctoral applicants to the School of Engineering, with no minimum score.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Records Examination (GRE) is optional for all applicants.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants need not contact a faculty member first; completed applications go to the department admissions committee.
supervisor.quote: it is not required to connect with a faculty member in advance

funding.value: The school says PhD students are often offered full funding packages; each department sets amounts.
funding.quote: PhD students are often offered full funding packages.

entry_route.value: The school pages do not say whether a master's is needed.

toefl_min.value: Engineering minimum is TOEFL 4.0 overall for tests taken after January 21, 2026 (81 for earlier tests).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL* 4.0 overall for exams taken after January 21, 2026 81 for exams taken before January 21, 2026

english_waiver.value: The engineering exempt-country list does not include India, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: If you hold (or will by the time you begin studies at GW) a Bachelor's, Master's, or doctoral degree from one of the countries listed below, you are not required to submit an English proficiency exam.
